Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
Last(x, y) ::: x is the last in a sequence y.
InLocation(x, y) ::: x took place in location y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Premises:
SummerOlympicGames(tokyo) ::: The summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Last(tokyo, summerOlympicGames) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬InLocation(tokyo, locationOtherThanTokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was not in Tokyo.
